title: Dentistry doesn't start with a drill. It starts by thinking.
subtitle: Twenty years of practice based on clinical judgment. Diagnosis before treatment, written second opinions, transparent pricing. Care in English and Spanish, by appointment.

slides.title: Dentistry doesn't start with a drill. It starts by thinking.
slides.subtitle: Diagnosis before any procedure. A written plan. A clear explanation. You decide with information, not fear.

slides.title: Never underestimate a small spot
slides.subtitle: A small lesion can hide something larger. Before touching, you must interpret: pain, history, radiograph, location, judgment. Thinking is also part of treatment.

slides.title: Second opinion with clinical judgment
slides.subtitle: Someone told you that you need an important treatment. Before accepting, we review your case with no conflict of interest. A photo isn't enough to diagnose.
